title: Book 3 — Thalia, Chapter 415
paragraphs: The Table of the Sun is said to be this: a meadow outside the city, filled with the boiled meat of every kind of four-footed animal. The city's officials place the meat there at night. During the day, anyone who wishes may come and eat. The locals say the earth itself produces the food each night. That is the account of the so-called Table of the Sun.
